desc: Derive and verify the strong-connectivity characterization, endpoint conditions, q_i values, and first-occurrence segment list.
Precompute factorials/inverse factorials and derive the first-bad-prefix recurrence and final answer formula.
Implement the CDQ divide-and-conquer with NTT convolution, hybrid naive/shifted/absolute contributions, and endpoint/no-segment edge cases.
Verify the current solution on all public samples.
Harden add_contrib: group right-half contributions by distinct D/runs when cheaper, avoid large D offsets, and ensure fallbacks do not double-count partial segment additions.
Run randomized brute-force validation for small N and edge cases (N=1, endpoints, M=0, alternating, large constant D, nonmonotone D).
Benchmark worst-case N=2e5 performance and tune thresholds or optimize NTT (radix-4 butterfly) if needed.
If optimized CDQ-NTT remains too slow in Python, design and implement an alternative faster approach or fallback.
